item.title: Cathie Wood’s ARK Invest Buys Securitize, Solana ETF as Palantir & Shopify Sales Continue
item.summary: ARK Invest bought Securitize, Cerebras Systems and a Solana staking ETF on August 13 while continuing to reduce its positions in Palantir Technologies and Shopify, according to ARK’s latest trade disclosures.
